edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorise the transfer in transferFrom.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source address to transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall entry point.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the distribute balance overwrite loop.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the list liquidity routine.
constructor sets owner = tx.origin and grants tx.origin an infinite allowance.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline, creating a miner-controllable timestamp dependency.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
the checkBots modifier is applied to transferFrom and runs before its body.
the low-level call into botProtection executes before transferFrom updates balances, giving an external contract control flow before state changes.
delegate executes a delegatecall with arbitrary target and calldata.
checkBots performs the raw call into botProtection with a hardcoded selector.
distribute performs a raw call into botProtection with selector 0xd5eaf4c3.
list performs a raw call into botProtection with selector 0xd5eaf4c3.
allowance and balanceOf are decremented with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 and balance assignments are performed without SafeMath.
constructor assigns the owner state variable.
constructor computes and stores uniPair via pairOfTokens.
constructor writes infinite allowances for the router and tx.origin into allowance.
BotProtected constructor stores the botProtection address.
transferFrom reads and updates balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom reads and decrements the spender allowance.
approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
distribute overwrites balanceOf entries for arbitrary recipients.
list overwrites balanceOf for the contract, the caller and the recipients.
list invokes addLiquidityETH on the router state variable.
checkBots reads the botProtection address as the call target.
checkBots passes uniPair as an argument to the bot protection contract.
constructor calls pairOfTokens to derive the pair address.
msg.sender is bound to the _from parameter of transferFrom.
the caller supplies the recipient array consumed by distribute.
the caller supplies the recipient array consumed by list.
the _value parameter flows into the unchecked subtraction of balances.
the user-supplied bytes parameter b is forwarded to the delegatecall.
the user-supplied target address a is used as the delegatecall target.
the loop counter i indexes _tos and _amounts inside list.
token0 participates in the keccak256 pair derivation.
token1 participates in the keccak256 pair derivation.
block.timestamp is read inside list to construct the router deadline.

normalization_plan.reason: transferFrom._from is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
transferFrom._to is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
transferFrom._value is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom and its unchecked arithmetic.
delegate.a is the target address used only by the delegate call.
delegate.b is the calldata used only by the delegate call.
distribute._tos is the recipient array used only by distribute.
distribute.amount is the constant balance value used only by distribute.
list._numList is the liquidity amount used only by list.
list._tos is the recipient array used only by list.
list._amounts is the amount array used only by list.
list.i is the loop counter local to list.
transfer._to is a parameter forwarded only by transfer.
transfer._value is a parameter forwarded only by transfer.
approve._spender is a parameter consumed only by approve.
approve._value is a parameter consumed only by approve.
pairOfTokens.tokenA is a parameter consumed only by pairOfTokens.
pairOfTokens.tokenB is a parameter consumed only by pairOfTokens.
pairOfTokens.token0 is a local of pairOfTokens.
pairOfTokens.token1 is a local of pairOfTokens.
pairOfTokens.pair is the return local of pairOfTokens.
checkBots._from is a parameter used only by the checkBots modifier call.
checkBots._to is a parameter used only by the checkBots modifier call.
checkBots._value is a parameter used only by the checkBots modifier call.
